answer: Call it The Jade Attention Filter. The system tracks continuity of presence rather than mere activity. An attacker faces a lagoon of idle time to fake engagement. Each identity requires unbroken uptime for thirty days. The cost is real time and computational power. A single lapsed minute resets the counter to zero. This makes sybil creation economically impossible at scale. The oasis is only reachable through sustained, linear effort. You cannot buy shortcuts or bribe validators. The wall is the clock itself, not a fee.
